formulas.formula: A fresh start for your money: look back, clean up, and set up the year.
Setup: your name and the year. Today fills itself in.
Last Year: enter each month's income and spending, then answer the three questions.
Net Worth: list what you own and owe, on January 1 and today.
Debt Plan and Subscription Audit: pick a payoff method and decide what to keep or cut.
Reset Checklist: tick tasks off as you go. Goals and Check-ins keep the year on track.
Pay the highest interest rate first. Saves the most money.
Pay the smallest balance first. Quick wins keep you going.
Goes to your number 1 debt on top of its minimum.
Spend 10 minutes at the end of each month filling in one row.
Red = overdue or needs a fix.
New year, fresh start. You've got this.

=IF(R4=0,"Add tasks to the Reset Checklist to start.",IF(R7>0,R7&IF(R7=1," task is"," tasks are")&" overdue. Pick one to do today.",IF(R5=R4,"Reset complete. Enjoy the fresh start!",IF(R15<>"","Next debt to crush: "&R15&".","Keep going, one task at a time."))))
The year you are resetting for.
Your reset to-do list. Tick Done when finished. Add your own tasks in the empty rows.
Add up last year's income and spending
Scan last year's statements for surprises
Write down 3 money wins from last year
Start a sinking fund for yearly bills
List every debt with rate and minimum
Set up autopay for all minimums
Call and ask for a lower card rate
Automate a payday transfer to savings
Review health, car and home insurance

Paid off the dentist bill and kept groceries on budget.
Eating out crept up in the summer.
One habit for the new year
Everything you own (Asset) and owe (Debt). Fill in January 1, then update Today whenever you like.
Avalanche = highest rate first. Snowball = smallest balance first. Your extra payment goes to debt number 1.
List every subscription. Decide Keep, Cancel or Downgrade (with the new price). See what you save in a year.
Your money goals for the new year. Update Saved so far as you go.
End of each month: net worth, what you saved and spent, and one win.
